notes.title: Steel Fight: Major Update
notes.notes:
Tournament Mode

New game mode added on arcade mode: Beat the AI without retrying
New unlockable feats and achievements.
Final score limit of player, on arcade mode, increased.


General Improvements

Sound tracks, during the matches, with more variation.
Sound effect of character when taking damage.
Adjustments and corrections of AI and the difficulty levels.
The dash movements of characters now have invincible frames, able to dodge opponent's attacks.

notes.title: Gameplay Update 10/29/2019
notes.notes:
Characters can now defend by holding button.
Characters with defense ability absorb 90% of damage on defending.
Some minor bugs fixed and adjustments.
